NONE: › written abbreviation for as far as I know: used when you believe that something is true, but you are not completely certain
據我所知（as far as I know的縮寫）
› from or at a great distance

example: People came from afar to see the show.
人們從很遠的地方趕來觀看表演。
humorous I've never actually spoken to him - I've just admired him from afar.
我從來沒有跟他說過話——我只是「敬而遠之」。
